understanding.purpose: 帮助读者按药品查找规格、用法用量、服用频次和注意事项。
understanding.reading: 读者通常先定位药品名称，再横向读取同一行的用药信息；比较药品时则会纵向查看规格、用量和频次。行内关联应清楚，即使某些单元格需要换行。
groups: 药品名称用于识别每一行，规格用于区分药品及其包装。
用法用量与频次共同说明如何用药，阅读时应结合起来。
注意事项是补充说明，通常比其他列更适合分行阅读。
keep_intact: 数字与单位、剂量和频次数值应尽量保持完整，避免产生歧义。
药品名称应尽量保持易于辨认，尤其是名称中的字母和数字。
may_wrap: 注意事项可按语义自然换行；其较长内容很可能决定行高。
用法用量可在短语之间换行，规格可在包装数量与剂量之间换行。
其他列可以利用注意事项形成的行高容纳适度换行。

bad.why: The frequency column breaks 每日 across lines in every data row, making the schedule harder to scan and compare.
The frequency column splits 每日 across lines, while the extra width given to precautions does not produce the shorter rows seen in r1B.

final.rationale: r2A keeps each 每日 frequency together and gives the long precautions enough width to remain readable without dominating the table as strongly as in the narrower versions. Its four data rows retain a comparatively consistent rhythm, and drug names, doses and precautions can be followed across each row. The wrapped 药品名称 and 用法用量 headers are a reasonable cost at this viewport width.

general: Give width to columns according to their content and reading role; equal widths can leave dense prose cramped.
Preserve frequently compared expressions as readable units, even when the browser reports no mid-word splits.
Judge row height alongside the clarity of each cell: a shorter table can still be harder to scan.
specific: The 频次 column needs enough room to keep 每日 together.
The long 注意事项 text benefits from substantially more width than the other columns.

final.tradeoffs: r1C, r3A and r3B give more room to some short fields and improve certain line breaks, but their narrower precautions column produces much taller rows. r1B makes the table shorter, but fragments the frequency expressions.
final.uncertain: The ranges are approximate, independent width adjustments around r2A, with compensating changes distributed among the other columns to stay within 359px. They are not browser-verified equivalence boundaries; small changes near a wrapping threshold can alter the layout abruptly.

B.why: 注意事项比 A 易读，频次也较完整；但规格和用法列过窄，多处将剂量、单位或“口服”拆开。

C.why: 频次列极窄，“每日”和次数被拆成多行；药品名称也被切碎，影响逐行核对。

D.why: 注意事项有较多空间，频次基本完整；但规格和用法仍被挤成短行，剂量和给药方式不易一眼读清。

E.why: 注意事项较宽，但频次列把“每日”拆开，规格和用法也有明显碎行，影响用药信息的快速核对。

F.why: 频次保持较完整，注意事项有可读的行宽；规格和用法仍偏窄，多个剂量及“口服”被拆行。
